name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
steps: Fit parallel handles to the high pulley and adjust the thigh pads to hold your legs in place.
Grip the handles with palms facing each other and sit tall with your arms overhead and a slight backward lean.
Pull the handles smoothly down toward your upper chest by driving your elbows straight downward beside your ribs.
Control the handles slowly back overhead to full arm extension without letting the stack slam.
tips: Keep your chest lifted toward the handles and pull your shoulder blades down as you descend.
Avoid rocking backward excessively to heave heavier weight.
